title: Design System: 音格 · 中古音韵反射矩阵

display.purpose: Selected-slot reconstructions and enlarged phonetic evidence.

title.purpose: Evidence headings and emphasized panel labels.

body.purpose: Controls, primary readings, and concise explanatory copy.

label.purpose: Coordinate captions, group labels, metadata, and provenance.

mono.purpose: Slot IDs, schema labels, and positional readouts.

shadows.name: pressed-density-state
shadows.purpose: Seats the selected density option inside its segmented field.

shadows.name: detail-modal-separation
shadows.purpose: Separates the active modal evidence page from the dimmed matrix.

shadows.name: selected-registration
shadows.purpose: Uses a neutral paper fill and ink corner without a click shadow.

motion.name: layer-state
motion.purpose: Layer button background, text, and border changes.

motion.name: control-state
motion.purpose: Search and standard control focus changes.

motion.name: filter-popover
motion.purpose: Reveals authored listbox options without delaying selection.

motion.name: selected-column-reveal
motion.purpose: Brings the selected initial column into the visible matrix viewport deterministically.

motion.name: reduced-motion
motion.purpose: Collapses animation and transition while preserving state changes.

components.name: Secondary Header Action
components.description: A compact ruled action that recedes behind matrix selection and layer controls.
components.css: .ds-button-secondary { height: 34px; display: inline-flex; align-items: center; justify-content: center; gap: 7px; padding: 0 11px; border: 1px solid var(--rule, #d4d8d4); border-radius: var(--radius-control, 4px); color: var(--ink-2, #42494d); background: var(--paper-raised, #ffffff); font: 400 12px "Noto Sans CJK SC", "Source Han Sans SC", sans-serif; transition: border-color 160ms ease-out, background 160ms ease-out; } .ds-button-secondary:hover { border-color: var(--rule-strong, #b9c0bc); background: var(--paper-muted, #eceeeb); } .ds-button-secondary:active { transform: translateY(1px); } .ds-button-secondary:focus-visible { outline: 2px solid var(--focus, #1f6f93); outline-offset: 2px; }

components.name: Global Search
components.description: A compact search field with a technical enter-key cap and mineral focus registration.
components.html: <form class="ds-search" role="search"><svg viewBox="0 0 24 24" width="17" height="17" aria-hidden="true"><circle cx="11" cy="11" r="6" fill="none" stroke="currentColor" stroke-width="1.6"/><path d="m16 16 4 4" fill="none" stroke="currentColor" stroke-width="1.6"/></svg><input aria-label="搜索字、格位或拟音" placeholder="查字 / 格位 / IPA"><kbd>↵</kbd></form>
components.css: .ds-search { width: min(100%, 460px); height: 38px; display: grid; grid-template-columns: 20px 1fr auto; align-items: center; gap: 8px; padding: 0 10px; border: 1px solid var(--rule-strong, #b9c0bc); border-radius: var(--radius-control, 4px); color: var(--ink-3, #6d7578); background: var(--paper, #f6f7f4); transition: border-color 160ms ease-out, background 160ms ease-out; } .ds-search:focus-within { border-color: var(--accent, #245a72); background: var(--paper-raised, #ffffff); } .ds-search input { min-width: 0; border: 0; outline: 0; color: var(--ink, #171b1d); background: transparent; font: 400 13px "Noto Sans CJK SC", "Source Han Sans SC", sans-serif; } .ds-search kbd { min-width: 24px; padding: 2px 5px; border: 1px solid var(--rule, #d4d8d4); border-bottom-color: var(--rule-strong, #b9c0bc); border-radius: 3px; color: var(--ink-3, #6d7578); background: var(--paper-raised, #ffffff); font-size: 11px; text-align: center; }

components.name: Active Layer Button
components.description: The filled Z-layer registration state inside the horizontally scrolling layer rail.
components.css: .ds-layer-button { min-width: 48px; height: 31px; padding: 0 9px; border: 1px solid var(--accent, #245a72); border-radius: 3px; color: var(--paper-raised, #ffffff); background: var(--accent, #245a72); font: 400 12px "Noto Sans CJK SC", "Source Han Sans SC", sans-serif; transition: background 140ms ease-out, color 140ms ease-out, border-color 140ms ease-out; } .ds-layer-button:hover { background: var(--accent-dark, #173f52); } .ds-layer-button:active { transform: translateY(1px); } .ds-layer-button:focus-visible { outline: 2px solid var(--focus, #1f6f93); outline-offset: 2px; }

components.name: Filter Listbox
components.description: A custom compact category filter with authored listbox semantics and full keyboard operation.
components.html: 调类
components.css: .ds-filter { position: relative; display: inline-flex; align-items: center; gap: 6px; color: var(--ink-3, #6d7578); font: 400 11px "Noto Sans CJK SC", "Source Han Sans SC", sans-serif; } .ds-filter > button { min-width: 86px; height: 32px; padding: 0 10px; border: 1px solid var(--rule, #d4d8d4); border-radius: 3px; color: var(--ink-2, #42494d); background: var(--paper, #f6f7f4); } .ds-filter [role="listbox"] { position: absolute; top: 38px; left: 18px; width: 132px; padding: 4px; border: 1px solid var(--rule-strong, #b9c0bc); background: var(--paper-raised, #ffffff); box-shadow: 0 10px 24px rgb(31 45 40 / .14); } .ds-filter [role="option"] { width: 100%; height: 34px; border: 0; color: var(--ink-2, #42494d); background: transparent; text-align: left; } .ds-filter [role="option"][aria-selected="true"] { color: var(--accent-dark, #173f52); background: var(--accent-wash, #eef5f7); font-weight: 650; }

components.name: Selected Phonology Cell
components.description: The signature ruled matrix cell, using a neutral selected state without a tap highlight or box shadow.
components.css: .ds-matrix-cell { position: relative; width: 110px; height: 76px; display: flex; flex-direction: column; justify-content: center; gap: 2px; overflow: hidden; padding: 7px 8px 6px; border: 0; border-right: 1px solid var(--rule, #d4d8d4); border-radius: 0; color: var(--ink, #171b1d); background: #edf0ee; text-align: left; box-shadow: none; -webkit-tap-highlight-color: transparent; transition: background 130ms ease-out, color 130ms ease-out; } .ds-cell-register { position: absolute; top: 4px; left: 4px; width: 7px; height: 7px; border-top: 1px solid var(--ink-2, #42494d); border-left: 1px solid var(--ink-2, #42494d); } .ds-cell-top { display: flex; align-items: baseline; justify-content: space-between; gap: 4px; } .ds-cell-top b { font: 650 18px/1 "Noto Serif CJK SC", "Source Han Serif SC", serif; } .ds-cell-top code { color: var(--ink-3, #6d7578); font: 400 8px ui-monospace, monospace; } .ds-cell-reading { overflow: hidden; font: 400 12px "Charis SIL", "Doulos SIL", sans-serif; white-space: nowrap; } .ds-matrix-cell small { color: var(--ink-3, #6d7578); font-size: 9px; } @media (hover: hover) { .ds-matrix-cell:hover { background: var(--accent-wash, #eef5f7); } } .ds-matrix-cell:focus-visible { outline: 2px solid var(--ink-2, #42494d); outline-offset: -3px; }

components.name: Evidence Tabs
components.description: Three equal ruled tabs that register the current evidence section with a bottom line.
components.html: <nav class="ds-detail-tabs" aria-label="详情分区"><button class="ds-active" type="button">格位详情</button><button type="button">反射总览</button><button type="button">演变链</button></nav>
components.css: .ds-detail-tabs { width: 100%; display: grid; grid-template-columns: repeat(3, 1fr); border-bottom: 1px solid var(--rule-strong, #b9c0bc); background: var(--paper-raised, #ffffff); } .ds-detail-tabs button { position: relative; height: 40px; border: 0; border-right: 1px solid var(--rule, #d4d8d4); color: var(--ink-3, #6d7578); background: transparent; font: 400 11px "Noto Sans CJK SC", "Source Han Sans SC", sans-serif; } .ds-detail-tabs button:last-child { border-right: 0; } .ds-detail-tabs button:hover { color: var(--ink, #171b1d); background: var(--paper, #f6f7f4); } .ds-detail-tabs button.ds-active { color: var(--accent-dark, #173f52); font-weight: 650; } .ds-detail-tabs button.ds-active::after { content: ""; position: absolute; right: 9px; bottom: 0; left: 9px; height: 2px; background: var(--accent, #245a72); } .ds-detail-tabs button:focus-visible { outline: 2px solid var(--focus, #1f6f93); outline-offset: -3px; }

components.css: .ds-evidence-header { width: min(100%, 560px); padding: 18px 24px 16px; border-bottom: 1px solid var(--rule-strong, #b9c0bc); color: var(--ink, #171b1d); background: var(--paper-blue, #edf2f5); font-family: "Noto Sans CJK SC", "Source Han Sans SC", sans-serif; } .ds-evidence-id { display: flex; align-items: center; justify-content: space-between; } .ds-evidence-id code { color: var(--accent-dark, #173f52); font: 720 11px ui-monospace, monospace; letter-spacing: .08em; } .ds-evidence-id span { display: flex; align-items: center; gap: 5px; color: var(--ink-3, #6d7578); font-size: 9px; } .ds-evidence-id i { width: 6px; height: 6px; border-radius: 50%; background: var(--accent, #245a72); } .ds-evidence-title { display: flex; align-items: center; gap: 13px; margin-top: 12px; } .ds-evidence-title > b { width: 52px; height: 52px; display: grid; place-items: center; border: 1px solid var(--accent, #245a72); color: var(--accent-dark, #173f52); background: rgb(255 255 255 / .55); font: 680 29px "Noto Serif CJK SC", "Source Han Serif SC", serif; } .ds-evidence-title > span { display: flex; flex-direction: column; gap: 3px; } .ds-evidence-title strong { font: 650 21px "Charis SIL", "Doulos SIL", sans-serif; } .ds-evidence-title small { color: var(--ink-3, #6d7578); font-size: 10px; }

narrative.overview:
The shipped interface behaves like a working table in a phonology archive: cool paper fields, ink-black evidence, mineral-blue registration marks, and ruled coordinates. It is intentionally dense and rectilinear. The full-width matrix is the primary object; header, layer rail, custom filter controls, and the separate detail modal exist to orient or inspect it rather than compete with it.

Its visual thesis is stable coordinates with replaceable registration layers. Changing dialect or Sino-Japanese readings changes the cell contents and active layer state without changing the Middle Chinese X/Y skeleton. Selection opens a wide modal evidence page on desktop and an edge-to-edge modal page on narrow screens without permanently reducing matrix width.
keyCharacteristics: Cool archival paper rather than warm lifestyle neutrals.
Ink-first data with mineral blue reserved for active layers, aligned records, and plotted relationships; selected cells stay neutral.
Hairline rules, square data cells, and restrained control radii instead of detached dashboard cards.
A compact bilingual hierarchy built for repeated scholarly scanning.
Persistent provenance language distinguishes sourced 古音小镜 dialect records from illustrative Middle Chinese and Sino-Japanese content.

rules.name: The Blue-Is-State Rule
rules.body: Mineral blue marks a current layer, aligned record, control focus, or plotted relationship; selected matrix cells use neutral paper and ink.

rules.name: The Honest-Provenance Rule
rules.body: Sourced dialect records expose their 古音小镜 point ID and URL plus the site’s automatic-segmentation warning; illustrative layers retain unreviewed labels.

rules.name: The Three-Script Rule
rules.body: Use sans for interface language, serif for CJK evidence characters, and the IPA/mono stacks only for phonetic or indexed data; do not collapse all three into one generic face.

rules.name: The Coordinate-Persistence Rule
rules.body: Responsive layouts may compress chrome and relocate details, but they never reorder, summarize away, or replace the full X/Y matrix.

rules.name: The Evidence-Lift Rule
rules.body: Shadow is reserved for the active detail modal or a tiny pressed control state; ordinary data regions stay ruled and flat.

rules.name: The Ruled-Plane Rule
rules.body: If content belongs to the same coordinate or evidence structure, separate it with a shared rule or paper tone rather than wrapping it in another rounded card.

dos: Do preserve the matrix as the dominant working plane and keep Middle Chinese coordinates fixed when the active reflex layer changes.
Do use mineral blue only for active, selected, aligned, focused, or plotted relationships.
Do use one-pixel rules and paper-tone shifts to group dense information before considering elevation.
Do keep serif CJK characters, IPA forms, slot IDs, reading layers, tone categories, tone values, and sandhi conditions visually distinct and separately legible.
Do distinguish sourced dialect records, illustrative reconstructions, uncollected readings, and third-party rights cautions explicitly.
Do preserve semantic grid/table roles, accessible names, selected-cell reveal, focus containment/restoration, visible focus, and reduced-motion behavior when extending components.
donts: Don't turn the workbench into a dashboard of detached rounded cards, metric tiles, or decorative charts.
Don't use gradients, glass blur, glow borders, pill controls, or large soft shadows; they contradict the shipped archival material.
Don't use mineral blue as a broad decorative background or introduce a second competing accent family.
Don't collapse the mobile matrix into cards or hide phonological dimensions; keep the full scrollable coordinate plane and open details in the separate modal page.
Don't present illustrative values as cited scholarship, discard alternate reflex rows, strip 古音小镜 point attribution, or suppress the source site’s automatic-segmentation warning.
Don't enlarge every label to consumer-app proportions; preserve the compact hierarchy while maintaining focus, contrast, and zoom legibility.
